CA1822.fullDescription: Los miembros que no tienen acceso a datos de instancia o que llaman a métodos de instancia se pueden marcar como static. Después de marcar los métodos como static, el compilador emitirá los sitios de llamada no virtuales para estos miembros. Esto puede proporcionar una mejora apreciable del rendimiento del código sensible al rendimiento.

CS0108.fullDescription: Se declaró una variable con el mismo nombre que una variable de un tipo base. Sin embargo, no se usó la palabra clave new. Esta advertencia le informa de que debería usar new. La variable se declaró como si new se hubiera usado en la declaración.

S2068.fullDescription: Hard-coding credentials in source code or binaries makes it easy for attackers to extract sensitive information, especially in distributed or open-source applications. This practice exposes your application to significant security risks.

S6418.fullDescription: Hard-coding secrets in source code or binaries makes it easy for attackers to extract sensitive information, especially in distributed or open-source applications. This practice exposes credentials and tokens, increasing the risk of unauthorized access and data breaches.

S6444.shortDescription: Regular expressions should be executed with a timeout
S6444.fullDescription: Regular expressions without a timeout can be exploited to cause a Denial-of-Service attack.

S6962.shortDescription: You should pool HTTP connections with HttpClientFactory
S6962.fullDescription: In frequently used code paths, such as controller actions, you should avoid using the HttpClient directly and opt for one of the IHttpClientFactory-based mechanisms instead. This way, you avoid wasting resources and creating performance overhead.

S6966.fullDescription: In an async method, any blocking operations should be avoided.
